scope: Independent completed pilot replay and provenance validation; no live calls by auditor. Provider billing/shutdown checked separately by parent.
selection: exact first10 original ordered dev IDs
checks: explicit observation allowlist and exact visited history
all reported usage totals and outputcaps
independent path/correctness/solver+controller cost reconstruction including stop
all domain summaries and bootstrap/paired utility summaries
limitations: Ten development questions are a pipeline pilot, not a held-out performance result.
No statistically established general advantage; repair-once matches accuracy with fewer tokens on this sample.
Native private Modal RPC was tested; generic HTTPS provider compatibility remains untested.
Token usage is verified against backend-reported totals and reviewed tokenizer implementation; output token IDs are not separately stored for retokenization audit.
Token penalty is a proxy across the3B solver and14B controller, not FLOPs or dollars.
Actual dollar cost and all-app shutdown require provider ledger/operational confirmation.
